answer: Because the timing is recorded against the relic challenge, the glacier audit can replay the orchard history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 23 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3707 identities would post 4338 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
